svg.text: BUILD-TIME PREPARATION — Linux only: wimlib, mtools, objcopy
No Windows build host, no ADK, no DISM on the build side. Future: the owner (licensed media) supplies UKI + install.wim
• ISO SHA-256 + size; boot.wim / wimboot SHA-256
• in-box drivers: e1000e / I350 / I219, NVMe, AHCI
CRLF text; injected at boot, never written into a WIM
with DeviceHandle = that file system; StartImage
mkuki.sh: objcopy stub + .wimboot + .files (cpio: boot.wim ‖ FDO files)
wimboot patches the FDO files into X:\Windows\System32 on the fly while bootmgfw reads the WIM;
Microsoft's files are never edited. Payloads are real PE sections, so one SHA-256 covers it all.
Size: 502 MiB, under fdo-uefi-rs's 512 MiB URL-delivery cap (inline: no cap). The stock
BCD loads \sources\boot.wim, so the WIM is always served as boot.wim.
Same for all devices of this type
Specific to each device being onboarded
RV blob (TO0): owner's TO2 address for both stages
ed25519 / ecdsa / rsa public keys + device IP
→ known_hosts for a verified first connection
TO1 (to1d verified) → TO2 with TPM credential; voucher chain and owner signature verified
← BMO FSIM: Windows UKI (502 MiB, signed image-begin, SHA-256)
URL ~10 s / inline ~2.5 min; LoadImage / StartImage
Stage 2: WinPE (stock boot.wim in a RAM disk)
← Microsoft's WinPE + the injected FDO files from above
winpe-uki-stub parses .files (cpio), installs a read-only in-memory file system, starts wimboot from .wimboot on it
wimboot extracts bootmgfw.efi, BCD, boot.sdi from the WIM; patches the FDO files into X:\Windows\System32
bootmgfw → winload → WinPE boot.wim as X: in a RAM disk; winpeshl.ini starts fdo-stage2.cmd (not Setup)
injected; launched by winpeshl.ini; logs to stage2.log and the console; ends powered off
1. wpeinit: network up (in-box Intel driver, DHCP)
2. diskpart: target disk → GPT: EFI system S: (FAT32), MSR, Windows W: (NTFS)
4. fdo-endpoint.exe: TO1 → TO2 with credential reuse; TPM via TBS (tbs.dll), same TPM credential as Stage 1
→ Credentials FSIM: SSH public keys + IP
← Payload FSIM: install.wim (3.16 GB) streamed → W:\fdo\install.wim
← = server to device → = device to server
← Payload FSIM: admin public key → W:\fdo\authorized_keys
5. dism /Apply-Image install.wim index 1 → W:\ (scratch on W:)
6. bcdboot W:\Windows /s S: /f UEFI → "Windows Boot Manager" becomes first in the firmware boot order
7. stage: unattend → W:\Windows\Panther, SetupComplete.cmd → W:\Windows\Setup\Scripts, host keys → W:\fdo
QEMU/KVM: WinPE up → powered off in ~3 min (3.16 GB at ~29 MB/s, DISM apply 51 s)
power on: boots Windows Boot Manager from the target disk
oobeSystem: locale, OOBE pages hidden, local Administrator password
SetupComplete.cmd (SYSTEM): FDO host keys → C:\ProgramData\ssh (ACL: SYSTEM + Administrators only)
owner key → administrators_authorized_keys; sshd auto-start, started; firewall rule for 22/tcp
removes the private-key staging copies and both unattend copies (they hold the plaintext password)
QEMU/KVM: power on → sshd answering in ~41 s
FDO-provisioned SSH host keys (no TOFU) • key-only admin SSH • keys and sshd survive reboots
Windows Boot Manager first, so no re-onboarding on reboot • Server holds the keys for verified first SSH
